title: The Moving Sound Canyon
learning_focus: Longitudinal and transverse wave models; energy transfer; sound changes when source or receiver moves.
story_premise: A canyon communication system distorts signals as carts move toward and away from listening stations.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Longitudinal and transverse wave models; energy transfer; sound changes when source or receiver moves.

areas.title: Rope Ridge
areas.story: Model a transverse wave and identify motion relative to travel direction. Model a longitudinal wave with compressions and rarefactions.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The station in Rope Ridge is not working correctly.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Model a transverse wave and identify motion relative to travel direction.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe carefully, investigate Longitudinal and transverse wave models, record the evidence, and use it to restore the station.

Record observations and measurements before forming a conclusion.
